dedupe_keys.name: flood hazard and flood risk maps of bulgaria s four river basin districts 2022 update

description: The Bulgarian Ministry of Environment and Water publishes the flood hazard and flood risk maps for the four river basin districts of the country: the Danube, Black Sea, East Aegean and West Aegean districts. Drafts of the updated maps were put out for public consultation on 25 February 2022, with comments due by 26 April 2022, and the maps and the assessment of flood hazard and risk were corrected in response; the page links the final maps on the website of each Basin Directorate. The maps follow the updated national methodology for assessing flood hazard and risk, approved by ministerial order 833 of 30 August 2021, which is linked as a PDF. The maps support the flood risk management plans for 2022 to 2027, for which public consultations are listed alongside those for 2028 to 2033. Access is free online; the ministry site states that its content is subject to copyright, and no open licence is named. Caveats: the maps sit on four separate basin directorate sites, and the pages are in Bulgarian. Coverage is Bulgaria. It supports flood hazard exposure analysis of roads, railways, energy and water assets, settlements and critical facilities, and climate adaptation planning; related records are the FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer and the Bulgarian national disaster risk profile.
